summary: Account for every fuzz target with bounded serial campaigns and synthetic crash retention
details: Register all 25 native targets, including DSN parsing, and require complete discovery, target/seed execution and real campaign-phase evidence.
Run all smoke seeds on PRs and master pushes, with weekly serial campaigns, a hard hosted memory ceiling, foreground process cleanup and exact-source summaries.
Retain bounded synthetic crash inputs on failures and timeouts, keep raw logs outside public uploads, and document private security triage and public artifact visibility.

compatibility.notes: Development and CI tooling changes only. The existing DSN parser input budget is preserved. No production parser, evidence format, trust policy or runtime endpoint changes.

security: Use read-only CI permissions, pinned Actions and credential-free child environments; reject unsafe paths and incomplete evidence. All local heavy commands remain subject to the host RAM coordinator.
limitations: Synthetic crash artifacts may be publicly visible; maintainers must privately assess suspected vulnerabilities before publishing regressions.
Finite campaigns supplement deterministic regression suites and do not establish exhaustive attack coverage or cryptographic assurance.
Workflow configuration is not evidence of a successful hosted campaign or a required branch-protection check.
